svg.title: One design re-planned from the face to the body, on tan skin. Face: a purple flower on the cheek with a teal vine curling up past the eye to a small flower at the temple. Arm: the same flower on the back of the hand, the vine turned into a bracelet around the wrist and a vine that spirals down the forearm. Shoulder: the same flower on the shoulder cap, with the vine following the collarbone and a short vine down the upper arm.
